property_postcode.title: What is the property postcode?
property_postcode.description: The property must be in the fictional Alderwick area (AW1 to AW4).

tenure.title: What is your housing situation?
tenure.description: This grant is only for owner-occupiers, but every option is shown so the service can explain the decision.

oneOf.title: I own the property and live there
I rent from a private landlord
I rent from the council or a housing association
I own the property but do not live there

main_home.title: Is this property your main home?
main_home.description: Choose yes only if you normally live at this address.

years_at_property.title: How many complete years have you lived here?
years_at_property.description: Enter 0 if you moved in less than a year ago.

preferred_contact.title: How should the council contact you?
preferred_contact.description: No message is sent in this prototype.

household_size.title: How many people normally live in the property?
household_size.description: Include adults and children who use this as their main home.

financial_route.title: Which financial condition applies to your household?
financial_route.description: You only need to meet one route: a listed income-related benefit or household income below £25,000 before tax.

oneOf.title: Someone receives a qualifying income-related benefit

benefit_type.title: Which qualifying benefit is received?
benefit_type.description: Choose the main benefit used for this application.

annual_income.title: What is the household’s annual income before tax?
annual_income.description: Enter a whole-pound amount for everyone who normally lives in the home.

savings_band.title: How much does the household have in savings?
savings_band.description: Include savings and investments, but not the home you live in.

repair_type.title: What is the main repair?
repair_type.description: Choose the closest category. Follow-up questions change according to this answer.

repair_description.title: Describe what has happened
repair_description.description: Say what stopped working or became unsafe, when it began, and which rooms are affected. Do not include medical details.

problem_started.title: When did the problem begin?
problem_started.description: An approximate period is enough for this prototype.

heating_status.title: What heating or hot water is available now?
heating_status.description: This question only applies to heating and hot-water repairs.

oneOf.title: No main heating or hot water
Some heating or hot water remains

electrical_risk.title: Is there an immediate electrical warning sign?
electrical_risk.description: Examples include sparks, burning smells, repeated tripping, or exposed live parts.

structural_risk.title: Is any part of the home unsafe to use?
structural_risk.description: This question only applies to structural repairs.

immediate_impact.title: How is the problem affecting the home now?
immediate_impact.description: Choose the most serious current effect.

oneOf.title: There is an immediate safety risk
An important room cannot be used

temporary_measures.title: Have you taken any temporary safety measures?
temporary_measures.description: For example, switching off power at the fuse box or using another safe source of heat.

estimated_cost.title: What is the expected repair cost?
estimated_cost.description: Enter a whole amount from £250 to £7,500, including tax.

quote_status.title: Do you have a written contractor estimate?
quote_status.description: The prototype records readiness only; it does not upload documents.

oneOf.title: Yes, I have a written estimate

contractor_name.title: What is the contractor or company name?
contractor_name.description: Enter the name shown on the written estimate.

photo_status.title: Do you have clear photographs of the problem?
photo_status.description: Nothing is uploaded in this prototype.

ownership_evidence.title: Do you have evidence that you own the property?
ownership_evidence.description: A mortgage statement or title record would be accepted in a real service. Nothing is uploaded here.

oneOf.title: No, I need help finding it

declaration_accuracy.title: I confirm that the answers are accurate to the best of my knowledge
declaration_accuracy.description: Only the applicant can make this declaration. An agent cannot propose or confirm it.
